description: HIGH-vulnerability client (age 82, moderate knowledge) proposed equity derivative — R1 hard fail (moderate < advanced) + R5 hard fail (HIGH vuln + RC 6 >= 5) → UNSUITABLE. R4 passes because can_afford_total_loss=true.
client_narrative: Yusuf Osman is 82 years old and retired. He receives a monthly pension of approximately 1,670 euros. He has 70,000 euros in accessible savings and is considering investing 40,000 euros with a 5-year outlook, primarily to generate additional income. He has been investing in individual equities and mutual funds for many years and is comfortable with market fluctuations — 'I understand that values go up and down.' He rates his risk tolerance at 5 out of 10. This 40,000 euros is discretionary savings and he has stated clearly that he is prepared to lose the full amount without it affecting his essential living expenses.
product_narrative: The product is a single-stock call option on a large-cap European company traded on a regulated exchange. The holder acquires the right — but not the obligation — to buy shares at a fixed strike price on a defined expiry date. The entire premium paid may be lost if the option expires out of the money. The product is classified COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a) as a derivative with a non-linear payoff profile, requiring advanced product knowledge. It is a short-term speculative instrument with a minimum holding period of one year.
